🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: extremely weak sector breadth and a MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL, NVDA, INTC) — neither clear risk-on nor risk-off.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND; PFE (1W: +2.83% | 1M: +2.72%) ABOVE TREND. Energy shows selective strength: XOM (1W: +1.66% | 1M: +2.96%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +0.97% | 1M: +1.25%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Broad weakness across cyclicals and defensives: Technology (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +1.99%) showing internal stress with leaders mixed; Financials (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -6.26%) BELOW TREND on major names; Real Estate (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -5.75%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: RCL (1W: +10.98% | 1M: -6.15%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +4.95% | 1M: +8.15%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +7.39%) ABOVE TREND, MAR (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology); Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -6.11% | 1M: -11.38%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -6.40% | 1M: +29.57%) CORRECTION, MCD (1W: -6.54% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +1.17%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in consumer discretionary and select tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: RCL (1W: +10.98%), AMAT (1W: +8.37%), ASML (1W: +4.95%), LRCX (1W: +4.26%), TXN (1W: +3.79%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (AAPL, NVDA, INTC) — tactical moves, not a broad trend confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed / CORRECTION pockets: AAPL (1W: -3.05% | 1M: +3.03%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: +2.20% | 1M: -0.89%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.56%) CORRECTION, META (1W: +0.30% | 1M: +27.91%) ABOVE TREND. Sector-level 1W weakness masks strong names in semicap (AMAT, ASML, LRCX) and AI leaders.

8. Financials Outlook?
Under pressure with short-term rebounds: JPM (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +1.06% | 1M: -4.12%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.38% | 1M: -5.33%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: -1.23% with mixed internals — watch for confirmation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Relative defensive outperformance: LLY (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +0.85%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +3.27% | 1M: -2.03%) RECOVERY, NVS (1W: +3.14% | 1M: -5.27%) RECOVERY. Healthcare is the only sector with positive 1W aggregate performance.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective ABOVE TREND names in semicap and healthcare (AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND; TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to broad cyclical consumer laggards and weak real estate; monitor major-cap divergences (AAPL, NVDA, INTC) before adding beta. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow top-performer concentration.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +4.95% | 1M: +8.15%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: EL (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND, MCD (1W: -6.54% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare — only sector with positive weekly performance (watch breadth within the group). BEARISH: Materials and Real Estate showing outsized weekly weakness; Technology internals deserve attention despite semicap strength.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor semicap follow-through: AMAT (sustain ABOVE TREND 1W strength) as trigger for tech reflation; AAPL (1W weakness confirming CORRECTION) as cap-weight risk trigger; NVDA (CORRECTION vs bullish buyback news) — loss of its 1M uptrend would widen divergence; TMO holding ABOVE TREND would signal defensive strength.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+85): NVDA (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.56%) CORRECTION — $150B buyback bullish but 1W softness = short-term divergence to watch. RCL (+80): RCL (1W: +10.98% | 1M: -6.15%) RECOVERY — bookings/guidance jump confirmed by strong 1W move. AMAT (+55): AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND — positive headlines confirmed by price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MCD (-50): MCD (1W: -6.54% | 1M: -11.08%) BELOW TREND — negative story confirmed by price weakness. NVS (-50): NVS (1W: +3.14% | 1M: -5.27%) RECOVERY — bearish headline on paused studies but 1W strength is a divergence to monitor. AMZN (-45): AMZN (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -7.42%) BELOW TREND — legal headwinds matching price pressure.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. AMAT (1W: +8.37% | 1M: +10.90%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +4.95% | 1M: +8.15%) ABOVE TREND and TMO (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +9.31%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, NVDA, INTC) and extremely weak sector breadth (Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive) — monitor for confirmation before shifting net exposure.
